app.title: CogniCare NER
app.tagline: Cognitive Care & Memory Assistance for Elders
app.offlineNotice: You are currently offline. All games and reminders work without internet!

simple.welcome: Good day! What would you like to do?
simple.callCaregiverDesc: Connect with your family or health worker

games.hubSubtitle: Gentle, culturally familiar games that adapt to your pace
games.memoryMatchDesc: Pair familiar objects from Assam and the North East (Japi, Tea, Dhol, Rhino, Bamboo)
games.memoryMatchInstruction: Tap on cards to turn them over and find matching pairs. Take your time, there is no hurry.
games.routineRecallDesc: Arrange your everyday activities in chronological order from morning to bedtime
games.routineRecallInstruction: Tap the activities in the order you do them every day: from waking up in the morning to sleeping at night.
games.completedDesc: You completed the session with great attention.
games.correctOrder: Great! That is the right sequence.
games.tryAgainOrder: Not quite yet. Try placing them in morning to night order.

reminders.subtitle: Clear, visual reminders for medication, hydration, and daily wellbeing
reminders.alertDueDesc: It is time for your scheduled care activity:
reminders.label: Reminder Name
reminders.noReminders: No reminders scheduled for this category.

dashboard.title: Caregiver & Clinician Dashboard
